title: Achieve global rigidity by pinning nodes

statement.text: Given a graph <math>G(V,E)</math>, find a minimum cardinality set <math>S \subset V</math> of nodes such that adding a complete graph on <math>S</math> renders the graph <math>G+K_S</math> [[Rigid graph|globally rigid]] in 2-dimensional space.

status_observation.evidence: pinned EGRES Open MediaWiki revision and categories
